title: Visible-light-induced decarboxylative acylation of unsaturated hydrocarbons with α-oxocarboxylic acid via Csp2–Csp2 cross-coupling: a facile access to chalcones
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,5176-5181
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00684H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aman Singh, Ambuj Kumar Kushwaha, Shikha Pandey, Pooja Kumari, Ankur Yadav, Sundaram Singh
We describe an efficient strategy for synthesizing chalcones via photocatalytic decarboxylative cross-acyl coupling of α-oxocarboxylic acid with styrene under visible light irradiation as a sustainable energy input.
